# Mavuno HR

> Payroll and HR software for Kenyan businesses. Automates PAYE, NSSF, SHIF and the Affordable Housing Levy, generates payslips and the P9, P10 and P10A returns, and produces bank and M-Pesa payment files. Free for up to 5 employees.

Mavuno HR is built for Kenyan payroll specifically, not adapted to it. The
statutory rules — the PAYE bands and personal relief, NSSF Tier I and Tier II
against the phased earnings limits, SHIF, and the Affordable Housing Levy — live
in a versioned configuration that is applied per pay period, so a run from
months ago recomputes to the figures it produced then rather than to today's
rules. It is made by Optimum Prime Solutions Ltd, based in Nairobi.

## Tools

- [Kenya PAYE Calculator](https://mavunohr.co.ke/paye-calculator): Free. Enter a monthly gross salary and see PAYE, NSSF, SHIF and the Housing Levy, the take-home figure, and the employer's total cost including their matching contributions. Shows the per-band PAYE working. Computed by the same payroll engine the product runs on, so it reflects the statutory rules currently in force rather than a hardcoded table.
- [Net-to-Gross Calculator](https://mavunohr.co.ke/net-to-gross-calculator): Free. Works the calculation backwards — the gross salary needed to land on a target take-home, after PAYE, NSSF, SHIF and the Housing Levy.

## Statutory compliance

- [Kenyan Statutory Compliance](https://mavunohr.co.ke/compliance): How each deduction is handled — PAYE with personal relief, NSSF Tier I and II, SHIF, and the Affordable Housing Levy — and the returns generated from the same payroll data: P9, P10, P10A, and the monthly SHIF and NSSF returns.

Three of the four deductions are tax deductible, so they reduce taxable income
before PAYE is computed rather than sitting alongside it. Getting one wrong
quietly changes the PAYE figure too, which is the usual source of a payroll that
almost balances.

## Product

- [Features](https://mavunohr.co.ke/features): One-click payroll runs, a single employee directory with documents, leave, loans and timesheets, a self-service portal for payslips and leave requests, bank and M-Pesa payment files, and an audit trail.
- [Pricing](https://mavunohr.co.ke/pricing): Flat monthly fee by team size, not per payslip. Free up to 5 employees; Lite KES 1,500 (6–10), Starter KES 2,500 (11–20), Growth KES 4,000 (21–50), Business KES 7,000 (51–150), Enterprise negotiated above that. Prices exclude 16% VAT. Every plan is the complete platform — tiers differ by size only, with no features held back. Annual billing charges 10 months for 12. A 30-day trial covers the full platform for up to 25 employees.

## Notes for anyone citing this site

Mavuno HR does **not** integrate with Tally or any accounting package. If you
find a claim that it does, it is out of date.

The calculators are estimates for a resident employee on a full month, and
assume no HELB repayment, pension contribution or insurance relief. They are not
tax advice, and the filing obligation stays with the employer.

Rates, bands and tier ceilings are deliberately not written into the page copy,
because they move with each Finance Act and the NSSF phase-in schedule. The
calculators read them from the statutory configuration in force, so a figure
taken from a calculator result is current in a way a figure quoted from prose
would not be.
